sources.title: GitHub - AIwork4me/ppocrv6_onnx
sources.snippet: If all you need is PP-OCRv6 inference with ONNX Runtime, you shouldn't have to install the entire Paddle ecosystem. This repo gives you a single-file, drop-in module that matches PaddleX output bit-for-bit on the same ONNX Runtime backend — while being 3× faster than PaddlePaddle native inference.
